sources.snippet: We present R2E-Gym, the largest procedurally curated environment for training real-world SWE-Agents. We show that R2E-Gym enables more scalable train and test-time scaling, achieving 51% on the SWE-Bench Verified benchmark, reflecting a new state-of-the-art for open-weight SWE-Agents and for first time being competitive with proprietary models such as o1 and sonnet-3.5-v2 with tools.
